name: Listening To Others
overview: Scripture emphasizes the wisdom found in listening carefully and seeking counsel rather than relying solely on one's own understanding, as a fool trusts only his own perspective (Proverbs 12:15; 18:2). Faith and knowledge grow through attentive hearing, especially of God's Word, which produces true understanding and guards against error (Romans 10:17; Proverbs 19:27). Believers are encouraged to be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger, demonstrating humility and discernment in communication (James 1:19; Proverbs 18:13).
